basic_details.job_title: DEI Research Staff Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One temporary post of Research Staff is open in the Naval Research Board, D.R.D.O., Govt. of India sponsored project "Optimal Development of Scare Underwater Naval Resources" at the Department of Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Dayalbagh Educational Institute (Deemed to be University), Agra, at Rs.42,000/- per month plus 20% HRA, initially for one year. Candidates with B.Tech./ M.Sc./ M.Tech, a CSE/IT/EEE or related background and strong C/ C++ programming skills may send a plain-paper application by hard copy or email to the Principal Investigator by 16 November 2026 (Monday).

how_to_apply: Applications go to the Principal Investigator, either as a hard copy or by email, and must be sent latest by 16 November 2026 (Monday).
Write the application on plain paper.

For a hard copy, send it to: Dr. Prem Prakash Vuppuluri, Principal Investigator, Department of Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Dayalbagh Educational Institute (Deemed to be University), Dayalbagh, Agra-282005.
For email, send it to [email protected] with the subject "Research Staff Application".
With the email, attach scanned copies of the academic and relevant research records.
Scanned copies of the academic and relevant research records (for email applications)

content_sections.heading: About DEI Research Staff
content_sections.text: Dayalbagh Educational Institute is a deemed-to-be university at Dayalbagh, Agra. This Research Staff post is in a research project sanctioned by the Naval Research Board, D.R.D.O., Govt. of India, to Dr. Prem Prakash Vuppuluri of the Department of Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering of the Institute. The notice is issued by the Registrar.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites "highly motivated and dynamic eligible candidates". The essential qualification for the Research Staff post, as printed: B.Tech./ M.Sc./ M.Tech (with good programming abilities and suitable CSE/IT/EEE or related background) In-depth knowledge of advanced data structure, algorithm design and software development Strong C/ C++ programming skills The notice does not mention an age limit, a desirable qualification, NET/GATE or a minimum period of experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Staff gets Rs.42,000/- per month plus 20% HRA. The post is temporary. It is initially for one year, with further extension subject to release of funds. The project itself runs for three years or till the completion of project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DEI Research Staff
content_sections.text: Applications go to the Principal Investigator, either as a hard copy or by email, and must be sent latest by 16 November 2026 (Monday). Write the application on plain paper. Attach certified copies of testimonials. For a hard copy, send it to: Dr. Prem Prakash Vuppuluri, Principal Investigator, Department of Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Dayalbagh Educational Institute (Deemed to be University), Dayalbagh, Agra-282005. For email, send it to [email protected] with the subject "Research Staff Application". With the email, attach scanned copies of the academic and relevant research records. Certified copies of testimonials Scanned copies of the academic and relevant research records (for email applications)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview will be held on 20 November 2026 (Friday). The notice does not mention the interview venue or reporting time. Candidates who apply are advised by the notice to check their email regularly after the last date for further details. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DEI Research Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Research Staff in the NRB research project at the Department of Electrical Engineering, DEI, Agra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DEI Research Staff post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent latest by 16 November 2026 (Monday).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DEI Research Staff post?
faq.answer: B.Tech./ M.Sc./ M.Tech (with good programming abilities and suitable CSE/IT/EEE or related background) with in-depth knowledge of advanced data structure, algorithm design and software development, and strong C/ C++ programming skills.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of DEI Research Staff?
faq.answer: The post carries Rs.42,000/- per month plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs.42,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the emoluments as Rs.42,000/- per month plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DEI Research Staff post?
faq.answer: Send a plain-paper application with certified copies of testimonials by hard copy to Dr. Prem Prakash Vuppuluri, Principal Investigator, Department of Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, DEI, Dayalbagh, Agra-282005, or by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What subject should I write in the email application?
faq.answer: The email subject must be "Research Staff Application", with scanned copies of the academic and relevant research records attached.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview for DEI Research Staff?
faq.answer: The interview will be held on 20 November 2026 (Friday), and no TA/DA will be paid for attending it.

faq.question: Q9. Is the DEI Research Staff post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary project post, initially for one year with further extension subject to release of funds, in a project running three years or till its completion, whichever is earlier.
